name: Symbol
description: This keyword is used in order to fetch the data for a particular time frame based on the selected instrument(Instrument name, traded instrument name, futures).
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used in order  to fetch the data for a particular time frame based on the selected instrument(Instrument name, traded instrument name, futures).

Generally, symbol will be used inside the other keywords to select the instrument of choice.

The symbol keyword will be a default keyword under most keywords. It will be available by default wherever instrument needs to be selected.

![Example](./images/img-1631878055.png)

In the above condition, symbol keyword is used to select the timeframe and the instrument name.

parameters.name: Instrument
parameters.description: Nested Instrument Name(...) / Futures(...) / Traded Instrument Name(...) keyword identifying the instrument.

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: Candle timeframe. MUST use Tradetron's shorthand enum (Rule 46) — never '1min'/'3min'.

parameters.name: Session
parameters.description: Which trading session's candles to use.
